papers.title: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for GUI Grounding via Region Consistency
papers.authors: Yong Du, Yuchen Yan, Fei Tang, Zhengxi Lu, Chang Zong, Weiming Lu, Shengpei Jiang, Yongliang Shen
papers.affiliations: Zhejiang University, Central South University, Zhejiang University of Science and Technology, SF Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出两种测试时缩放方法——GUI-RC（基于空间投票的测试时聚合）和GUI-RCPO（基于区域一致性的测试时强化学习），无需标注数据即可显著提升GUI grounding精度。

papers.title: OS Agents: A Survey on MLLM-based Agents for General Computing Devices Use
papers.authors: Unknown
papers.affiliations: 浙江大学（Zhejiang University），复旦大学（Fudan University），OPPO AI中心（OPPO AI Center），中国科学院大学（University of Chinese Academy of Sciences），中国科学院自动化研究所（Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences），香港中文大学（The Chinese University of Hong Kong），清华大学（Tsinghua University），上海交通大学（Shanghai Jiao Tong University），01.AI（01.AI），香港理工大学（The Hong Kong Polytechnic University）
papers.intro: 本文是一篇针对基于多模态大语言模型的操作系统代理（OS Agents）的全面综述，系统梳理了其基础组件、核心能力、构建方法（基础模型与代理框架）、评估协议与基准，并讨论了安全隐私、个性化等未来挑战。

papers.title: Evolving in Tasks: Empowering the Multi-modality Large Language Model as the Computer Use Agent
papers.authors: Yuhao Cheng, Liang Tang, Shuxian Li, Yukang Huo, Tiaonan Duan, Kaer Huang, Yanzhe Jing, Yiqiang Yan
papers.affiliations: Lenovo Research（Beijing, China）、 China Agricultural University（Beijing, China）
papers.intro: 本文提出Self-Evolution Agent (SEA)，通过自动可验证数据生成、高效分步强化学习和模型增强，仅用7B参数就达到了与32B/72B模型可比的计算机使用任务性能。

papers.title: MMBench-GUI: Hierarchical Multi-Platform Evaluation Framework for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Xuehui Wang, Zhenyu Wu, JingJing Xie, Zichen Ding, Bowen Yang, Zehao Li, Zhaoyang Liu, Qingyun Li, Xuan Dong, Zhe Chen, Weiyun Wang, Xiangyu Zhao, Jixuan Chen, Haodong Duan, Tianbao Xie, Chenyu Yang, Shiqian Su, Yue Yu, Yuan Huang, Yiqian Liu, Xiao Zhang, Yanting Zhang, Xiangyu Yue, Weijie Su, Xizhou Zhu, Wei Shen, Jifeng Dai, Wenhai Wang
papers.affiliations: 1上海人工智能实验室，2上海交通大学，3厦门大学，4中国科学技术大学，5香港科技大学，6哈尔滨工业大学，7清华大学，8南京大学，9复旦大学，10香港大学，11东华大学，12香港中文大学
papers.intro: 提出MMBench-GUI，一个层次化、多平台（Windows、macOS、Linux、iOS、Android、Web）的GUI智能体评估基准，包含四个递进能力级别（内容理解、元素接地、任务自动化、任务协作），并引入EQA指标同时评估任务成功率与执行效率。

papers.title: MS-DETR: Towards Effective Video Moment Retrieval and Highlight Detection by Joint Motion-Semantic Learning
papers.authors: Hongxu Ma, Guanshuo Wang, Fufu Yu, Qiong Jia, Shouhong Ding
papers.affiliations: Fudan University; Tencent Youtu Lab
papers.intro: MS-DETR通过解耦运动与语义特征、设计任务相互协作的编码器-解码器，并引入语料生成和对比去噪学习，有效提升了视频时刻检索和精彩片段检测的联合精度。

papers.title: Minimizing the Pretraining Gap: Domain-aligned Text-Based Person Retrieval
papers.authors: Shuyu Yang, Yaxiong Wang, Yongrui Li, Li Zhu, Zhedong Zheng
papers.tags: diffusion model, image generation, multimodal learning, video search
papers.affiliations: Xi'an Jiaotong University, Hefei University of Technology, University of Macau
papers.intro: 本文提出一种包含图像级领域自适应（Domain-aware Diffusion, DaD）和区域级多粒度关系对齐（Multi-granularity Relation Alignment, MRA）的统一管道，通过生成领域对齐的合成数据集SDA并联合全局-局部对齐，显著缩小预训练与真实数据之间的领域…

papers.title: TRACER: Efficient Object Re-Identification in Networked Cameras through Adaptive Query Processing
papers.authors: Pramod Chunduri, Yao Lu, Joy Arulraj
papers.affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology; National University of Singapore
papers.intro: TRACER是一个基于自适应查询处理框架的视频数据库管理系统，通过递归网络学习长期跨摄像头相关性，并结合概率自适应搜索算法，在满足高召回约束的前提下显著加速跨摄像头对象重识别查询。

papers.title: GTA1: GUI Test-time Scaling Agent
papers.authors: Yan Yang, Dongxu Li, Yutong Dai, Yuhao Yang, Ziyang Luo, Zirui Zhao, Zhiyuan Hu, Junzhe Huang, Amrita Saha, Zeyuan Chen, Ran Xu, Liyuan Pan, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Junnan Li
papers.affiliations: Salesforce AI Research（主要机构），The Australian National University，University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出GTA1，通过测试时缩放（test-time scaling）策略增强规划阶段的动作选择质量，并利用强化学习（GRPO）直接预测点击坐标，无需显式推理，从而实现Graphical User Interface（GUI）接地与任务执行的当前最优性能。

papers.title: R-VLM: Region-Aware Vision Language Model for Precise GUI Grounding
papers.authors: Joonhyung Park, Peng Tang, Sagnik Das, Srikar Appalaraju, Kunwar Yashraj Singh, R. Manmatha, Shabnam Ghadar
papers.affiliations: KAIST, AWS AI Labs
papers.intro: R-VLM通过两阶段放大定位机制和IoU感知加权交叉熵损失，将传统目标检测思想融入VLM，在多个GUI定位与导航基准上取得显著精度提升。

papers.title: Universal Video Temporal Grounding with Generative Multi-modal Large Language Models
papers.authors: Zeqian Li, Shangzhe Di, Zhonghua Zhai, Weilin Huang, Yanfeng Wang, Weidi Xie
papers.affiliations: SAI, Shanghai Jiao Tong University；ByteDance Seed
papers.intro: 论文提出UniTime，通过将时间戳token与视频token交错输入生成式多模态大语言模型，并配合自适应帧缩放和多阶段粗到细推理，实现了对任意时长、任意视角和任意主题视频的通用时间定位。

papers.title: YOLOv13: Real-Time Object Detection with Hypergraph-Enhanced Adaptive Visual Perception
papers.authors: Mengqi Lei, Siqi Li, Yihong Wu, Han Hu, You Zhou, Xinhu Zheng, Guiguang Ding, Shaoyi Du, Zongze Wu, Yue Gao
papers.affiliations: 清华大学（BNRist, THUIBCS, BLBCI, 软件学院）、太原理工大学（机械工程学院）、北京理工大学（信息与电子学院）、深圳大学（机电与控制工程学院、广东省人工智能与数字经济实验室（深圳））、香港科技大学（广州）（物联网学域、智能交通学域）及香港科技大学（电子与计算机工程系）、西安交通大学（人机混合增强智能全国重点实验室等）
papers.intro: 本文提出 YOLOv13，通过自适应超图计算（HyperACE）建模全局多对多高阶相关性，并基于全管道聚合分发范式（FullPAD）实现特征协同，以轻量级深度可分离卷积块降低计算量，在 MS COCO 上以更少的参数和 FLOPs 达到 SOTA 性能。

papers.title: OSWorld-Human: Benchmarking the Efficiency of Computer-Use Agents
papers.authors: Reyna Abhyankar, Qi Qi, Yiying Zhang
papers.affiliations: 1University of California, San Diego; 2GenseeAI, Inc
papers.intro: 本文首次系统分析了计算机使用代理在OSWorld基准上的延迟瓶颈，手工构建了包含人类最优轨迹的OSWorld-Human基准，并提出加权效率分数（WES），揭示最佳代理仍需2.7–4.3倍于人类的步骤数才能完成任务。

papers.title: OS-Harm: A Benchmark for Measuring Safety of Computer Use Agents
papers.authors: Thomas Kuntz, Agatha Duzan, Hao Zhao, Francesco Croce, Zico Kolter, Nicolas Flammarion, Maksym Andriushchenko
papers.affiliations: 1EPFL, 2Carnegie Mellon University
papers.intro: 本文提出了OS-Harm基准，构建于OSWorld环境之上，通过150个跨三种危害类别的任务和基于LLM的自动评判器，系统评估计算机使用代理的安全风险。

papers.title: DiMo-GUI: Advancing Test-time Scaling in GUI Grounding via Modality-Aware Visual Reasoning
papers.authors: Hang Wu, Hongkai Chen, Yujun Cai, Chang Liu, Qingwen Ye, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Yiwei Wang
papers.tags: visual grounding, object detection, scene understanding, gui

papers.intro: DiMo-GUI 是一个无需训练的即插即用框架，通过分离文本与图标模态、渐进式动态缩放和自适应停止机制，显著提升现有 GUI grounding 模型在复杂界面上的定位精度。

papers.title: Improving Personalized Search with Regularized Low-Rank Parameter Updates
papers.authors: Fiona Ryan, Josef Sivic, Fabian Caba Heilbron, Judy Hoffman, James M. Rehg, Bryan Russell
papers.tags: multimodal learning, image retrieval, CLIP, video search
papers.affiliations: Georgia Tech, Adobe Research, CIIRC CTU, UIUC

papers.title: Atomic-to-Compositional Generalization for Mobile Agents with A New Benchmark and Scheduling System
papers.authors: Yuan Guo, Tingjia Miao, Zheng Wu, Pengzhou Cheng, Ming Zhou, Zhuosheng Zhang
papers.affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University; Langboat Technology
papers.intro: 本文提出UI-NEXUS基准（系统定义三种组合操作类型，覆盖50个应用、100个任务模板）和AGENT-NEXUS调度系统（动态分解长程组合任务为原子子任务），将现有智能体在组合任务上的成功率提升24%–40%，同时保持推理成本可控。

papers.title: GUI-Actor: Coordinate-Free Visual Grounding for GUI Agents
papers.authors: Qianhui Wu, Kanzhi Cheng, Rui Yang, Chaoyun Zhang, Jianwei Yang, Huiqiang Jiang, Jian Mu, Baolin Peng, Bo Qiao, Reuben Tan, Si Qin, Lars Liden, Qingwei Lin, Huan Zhang, Tong Zhang, Jianbing Zhang, Dongmei Zhang, Jianfeng Gao

papers.title: AgentCPM-GUI: Building Mobile-Use Agents with Reinforcement Fine-Tuning
papers.authors: Zhong Zhang, Yaxi Lu, Yikun Fu, Yupeng Huo, Shenzhi Yang, Yesai Wu, Han Si, Xin Cong, Haotian Chen, Yankai Lin, Jie Xie, Wei Zhou, Wang Xu, Yuanheng Zhang, Zhou Su, Zhongwu Zhai, Xiaoming Liu, Yudong Mei, Jianming Xu, Hongyan Tian, Chongyi Wang, Chi Chen, Yuan Yao, Zhiyuan Liu, Maosong Sun

papers.title: SA-Person: Text-Based Person Retrieval with Scene-aware Re-ranking
papers.authors: Yingjia Xu, Jinlin Wu, Daming Gao, Zhen Chen, Yang Yang, Min Cao, Mang Ye, Zhen Lei
papers.tags: image retrieval, CLIP, multimodal learning, visual grounding, video search
papers.affiliations: Soochow University; Centre for Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hong Kong Institute of Science and Innovation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Multimodal Artificial Intelligence Systems (MAIS), Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences; Wuhan University; University of Chinese Academy of Sciences

papers.title: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
papers.authors: Qiushi Sun, Zhoumianze Liu, Chang Ma, Zichen Ding, Fangzhi Xu, Zhangyue Yin, Haiteng Zhao, Zhenyu Wu, Kanzhi Cheng, Zhaoyang Liu, Jianing Wang, Qintong Li, Xiangru Tang, Tianbao Xie, Xiachong Feng, Xiang Li, Ben Kao, Wenhai Wang, Biqing Qi, Lingpeng Kong, Zhiyong Wu
papers.affiliations: The University of Hong Kong, Shanghai AI Laboratory, Fudan University, Peking University, Nanjing University, East China Normal University, Yale University
papers.intro: 本文提出了ScienceBoard——一个包含多领域真实软件环境和169个高质量任务的评测平台，用于系统评估LLM/VLM驱动的自主代理在科学工作流中的表现，揭示了当前代理在复杂科学任务中的严重不足。
